run.name: Encompass Health Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (EHC)
run.summary: Encompass Health has a sound but reimbursement-exposed credit profile: leverage is modest and liquidity ample, while revenue depends on Medicare and Medicare Advantage and cash flow after distributions was negative in nine months 2026. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 2,599.1 and cash 76.2 at 30 Sep 2026 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1,379.0 (FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025). The company reports 1.9x and 1.8x. Same limitations; face-value debt of 2,630.0 would give 1.91x.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1,379.0 over 118.0, being 113.6 plus 90.2 for nine months 2026 less 85.8 for nine months 2025. The 85.8 is derived as interest expense 93.0 less amortization 7.2 and agrees with the deck bridge; cash paid for interest is not supplied for 2026.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and equivalents; availability as stated in the Q3 10-Q, consistent with 1,000 less 75.0 drawn less 53.6 letters of credit. Restricted cash of 24.0 and restricted marketable securities of 158.5 excluded.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Ownership, covenant definitions, guarantors and ratings are not evidenced, and leverage figures are analyst calculations rather than covenant ratios.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant definitions and debt agreements are not supplied, and the company's EBITDA is a management measure that deducts noncontrolling interests.
